text:
debrief db-021
1) The actor f-o-r-g-e-d the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r-s on t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s c-a-r-d l-o-g-s and t-h-e r-e-p-o-r-t s-h-o-w-s u-n-a-u-d-i-t-e-d e-d-i-t-s in t-h-e t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p f-i-e-l-d.
2) The actor d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d a b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-r-o-m a s-t-a-l-e b-a-c-k-u-p f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t a n-o n-e x-p-i-r-e-d c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e h-i-d-d-e-n in t-h-e v-a-u-l-t.
3) The actor b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d the l-i-v-e-n-e-s-s d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n m-o-d-u-l-e d-u-r-i-n-g e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t and f-a-i-l-e-d to c-l-e-a-r t-h-e c-a-s-h-e-d b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c b-r-i-e-f c-a-s-h-e.
4) The actor m-i-s-r-e-p-o-r-t-e-d the a-d-m-i-n i-d in t-h-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l and n-e-v-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w-e-d the p-r-i-v-i-l-e-g-e d-e-l-e-g-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g.
5) The actor d-e-l-e-t-e-d t-h-e t-e-m-p f-a-c-e i-m-a-g-e f-r-o-m the s-c-r-e-e-n-b-u-f-f-e-r and l-o-s-t t-h-e r-e-c-o-v-e-r-y s-t-r-e-a-m f-o-r the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
